batch.objective: Establish the shared semantic shell navigation directory and status/recovery grammar before route-family screens and establish the delivery stream control in the semantic shell so it is evidenced on an authorized batch
batch.prerequisites_and_held_inputs: MA-024 accepted; separate explicit future external Figma/Stitch production/write gate accepted; DESIGN_SYSTEM_IMPLICATIONS.md and component-primitives.csv reviewed
batch.required_visual_evidence: Required future evidence for the delivery stream control in the semantic shell (PRIM-001, ACT-09), present and reachable without a canvas in each of the four streams: one frame per stream with control and guidance visible. Frames and implementation annotations specify four native radio inputs sharing one name inside a fieldset with a legend plus a separate always-present Apply submit button; group accessible name reports the in-force stream while the checked radio reports the pending selection; Apply accessible name states that it applies the selection. Show persistent visible text inside the fieldset before Apply in both DOM reading order and visual order, programmatically associated with both the group and the Apply button; not tooltip title hover-only focus-only or accessible-description-only. Use the same wording in every stream to explain that applying the pending selection re-enters the experience while preserving current location; D-057 accepted stream-control copy bundle is required; runtime placeholders use verified facts and legal content remains gated. Review guidance before operation for sighted mouse users, keyboard users without assistive technology, screen-reader users and screen-magnifier users at 400% zoom; visible text must not be hidden or clipped. Later keyboard and screen-reader execution evidence must verify names associations and activation under UXTEST-046: selection changes only checked state without applying reloading transitioning or other accessibility-tree changes; only explicit Apply activation or native Enter submission of the same form to that button applies the stream; never apply on focus selection blur arrow movement or timeout. Verify announcements on group entry, radio movement and reaching Apply; screenshots alone cannot establish keyboard operability or accessible names. STATE-STREAM-CHANGED on TPL-GLOBAL-NAVIGATION in each of the four streams: polite announcement, focus not moved within the shell, scroll open panel and route preserved. STATE-PREFERENCE-WRITE-FAILED on TPL-GLOBAL-NAVIGATION in each of the four streams, following the ACT-11 pattern. Complete VP-320 and VP-DESKTOP shell frames; narrow disclosure; no-results/index-unavailable/offline/error; 404/410 context; forced-colors grayscale unavailable font/image keyboard and screen-reader evidence; BP-NFR-006 proof: dated later QA selects the then-current latest two stable Chrome Edge Firefox and Safari release families; proves Safari/iOS 16.4 minimum-floor mobile layout input virtual-keyboard and safe-area behavior; and proves semantic Quick Access recovery below the floor or when otherwise unsupported; TL-WARN-EXTEND proof: warn at least 20 seconds before expiry and offer a simple extension of at least 10x; preserve permitted data and last authoritative state and show accessible reauthentication; exact durations remain gated. Explicitly NOT required in B01: Reception, rooms, hotspots, the HUD, and every other World-content obligation. Those attach to the B07 templates under N-03 and are carried as the template-level presence sets that B07 already expresses.; STATE-PREFERENCE-READ-FAILED on the applicable navigation first-visit and return-visit hosts in each stream: disclose lost stored choice in the destination shell and offer reselection with a named /privacy notice link; STATE-STREAM-CEILING-REFUSED on applicable navigation and World hosts: refusal reason as a client fact, prior in-force value preserved, ceiling stated without error styling; World-host frames remain assigned to B07; legal copy remains held under D-051; D-052 ACT-40 reset evidence on TPL-RETURN-VISIT belongs to B07; staff sign-out remains separate; D-060 boundary and nearest-ancestor evidence is explicitly deferred to B07 via boundary-evidence-allocation.csv; same-shell frames never discharge boundary evidence
batch.validation_and_review: Independent design review; independent accessibility review; design-system and shell consistency inspection; normative WCAG 2.2 Level AA target review for every applicable full page and complete process including represented third-party steps; evidence does not claim current conformance
batch.stop_condition: Stop for unresolved navigation labels route activation search behavior privacy policy or a material identity/primitive change

profile.applies_to: Full-richness World stream on clients that pass the WebGL probe and report the highest device tier
profile.minimum_evidence: Contrast, target size and focus order measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control shown reporting S-HIGH as current with its accessible name legible in the annotation; MODE-STANDARD, MODE-REDUCED-MOTION, MODE-KEYBOARD and MODE-SCREEN-READER captures; no degradation vocabulary in any annotation. Axis intersection is explicit and counted once: where a frame required here would also satisfy another profile it is drawn once and annotated with both profile IDs, so no frame is counted twice and no obligation is discharged by an aggregate frame that names no stream. World-content obligations are not stated here; under N-03 they attach to TPL-WORLD-SHELL and TPL-WORLD-HUD
profile.annotation_requirements: Contrast target size and focus order are each measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control is annotated with its current value and its accessible name; no annotation may use degradation vocabulary
profile.exception_rule: A stream may be marked not applicable only where the WebGL probe makes it unreachable for every client; S-SEMANTIC may never be marked not applicable

profile.applies_to: Peer stream for clients without a WebGL context; semantic navigation with static imagery
profile.minimum_evidence: Every core journey completed end to end using only this stream; a named equivalent action for every route reachable in S-HIGH; contrast, target size and focus order measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control shown reporting S-SEMANTIC as current, with its accessible name legible in the annotation, reachable without a canvas; MODE-FORCED-COLORS, MODE-PRINT, MODE-KEYBOARD and MODE-SCREEN-READER captures; keyboard path and screen-reader reading order; no degradation vocabulary in any annotation. Axis intersection is explicit and counted once. World-content obligations are not stated here; under N-03 they attach to TPL-WORLD-SHELL and TPL-WORLD-HUD
profile.annotation_requirements: Contrast target size and focus order are each measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control is annotated with its current value and its accessible name; no annotation may use degradation vocabulary
profile.exception_rule: S-SEMANTIC may never be marked not applicable. MODE-PRINT applies here and is not covered by the MP-WORLD print exclusion, because S-SEMANTIC is the semantic shell and not the live World canvas. S-SEMANTIC is never drawn as STATE-WEBGL-UNSUPPORTED: that state belongs to the World shell losing a context it had, while S-SEMANTIC is a peer stream a client may be served from first paint, so it carries no failure heading no error styling and no language of escape recovery or fallback
